purpose: Fresh confirmation for Figure 2: held-out accuracy rises while the training loss does not decrease.
recipe_choice: Chosen on development data only: among the dev-sweep v2 recipes, h23_tf0p8_lw0p015_ev0p03_lv0p2 was the one whose cycle-mean training CE did not decrease between the first 10% and first 90% held-out crossings in all 4 dev pairs (max drawdown <= 0.25%), at a positive loss level (~0.25 log p). Post hoc with respect to the dev runs, prior to any confirmation run.
window_rule: select_p23_window.py (declared rule, applied to the 4 dev runs only): all dev runs pass P10, ND, FIT, H20, F04 below and window-min CE >= 0.1; largest minimum dA_H, ties within 0.005 -> shorter window, then earlier t0. Result: [6500, 16500], min dA_H 0.0607.

primary_endpoints.P10: raw training-CE relative variation max/min - 1 <= 10% over every update of [t0, t1]
primary_endpoints.ND: no loss decrease during generalization: T90 = first update > t0 with held-out accuracy >= 0.9 satisfies T90 <= t1 - 500; on [t0, T90] the two-update cycle-mean CE Lbar_t = (L_t + L_{t+1})/2 never falls more than 0.5% below its running maximum since t0, and Lbar(T90) >= Lbar(t0)
primary_endpoints.FIT: training accuracy 1 at every update of [t0, t1]

joint: P10 and ND and FIT and H20 and F04
decision_rule: The cohort replaces the current Figure 2 if the joint endpoint holds in at least 18 of 20 runs (two-sided 95% Wilson lower bound >= 0.70). Otherwise it is reported as a failed confirmation and the redrawn headline Figure 2 stays.
secondary: max drawdown and net change of Lbar on [t0, T90]
illustration_rule: any single-run illustration uses confirmation pair 1
environment: cloud container, 2 CPU cores, Python 3.11.15, numpy 2.4.4, scipy 1.17.1; a 1500-update rerun of dev pair 3 reproduced the Lightning dev trace to <= 5.3e-16 relative
